title: Dead-letter queues
explain: Repeated failures should not block the main stream. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Dead-letter queues" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Dead-letter queues, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
